characters.name: Assassin
characters.description: Select another character whom you wish to kill. The killed character loses their turn.

characters.name: Architect
characters.description: Gains two extra district cards. Can build up to 3 districts per turn.

characters.name: Thief
characters.description: Select another character whom you wish to rob. When a player reveals that character to take his turn, you immediately take all of his gold. You cannot rob the Assassin or the killed character.

characters.name: Magician
characters.description: Can either exchange their hand with another player's, or discard any number of district cards face down to the bottom of the deck and draw an equal number of cards from the district deck (can only do this once per turn).

character.name: King
character.description: Gains one gold for each yellow (noble) district in their city. They receive the crown token and will be the first to choose characters on the next round.
